Our Mission We're a team packed with solid industry experience who shares the common goal of making seismic security systems more affordable and accessible to everyone. We believe that advanced threat detection should never be out of reach for organizations that need it most. Our Story SensoGuard was founded in 2012 as a seismic security systems contractor, serving the Israeli Defense Forces and global militaries. Over more than a decade of development, we've transformed cutting-edge military-grade technology into intelligent solutions that operate in over 20 countries today. Our journey has been defined by continuous innovation and unwavering commitment to excellence. From our first standalone detectors to the world's first seismic sensor with embedded DSP technology, we've consistently pushed the boundaries of what's possible in perimeter security. Designed and Built in Israel Every SensoGuard sensor is meticulously designed, assembled, and manufactured in Israel.
